theme: Warm Light Mode default with soft dark mode support (Warm Rose / Sand / Charcoal / Dusty Terracotta)

headings.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-50
headings.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-100
headings.label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300

typography.font_rules: Do NOT use Inter for main headings. Use Plus Jakarta Sans or Outfit. Maintain tight tracking on titles.

colors.contrast_rule: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Never use transparent background on dropdowns or floating overlays - always use blur + semi-opaque white/dark surface with 1px border.

layout_and_navigation.app_shell: Mobile-first responsive shell with sticky header and floating bottom navigation tab bar (Calendar, Chat, Gallery) with top right status showing connected partner avatar / status
layout_and_navigation.header: Glassmorphism sticky top bar (`bg-amber-50/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-amber-200/40 z-40`). Must include brand name 'We2gether' with pairing code badge and partner status indicator.
layout_and_navigation.pairing_screen: Hero card layout for non-paired state: Option A 'Create Pairing Code' (generates 6-char code e.g. TOE2S6 with easy 1-tap copy button) and Option B 'Enter Pairing Code' (input box with instant join action). Includes quick visual preview of shared space features.
layout_and_navigation.bottom_navigation: Pill-shaped floating navigation bar on mobile & sticky desktop sidebar/bottom bar. Icons: Calendar (Events), Chat (Messages + Quick Reactions), Gallery (Moments). Highlight active tab with glowing terracotta accent.

pairing_flow.create_code: Shows prominent 6-character code with copy button, share link button, and pulsing waiting state ('Waiting for your partner to enter code...')
pairing_flow.enter_code: 6-character uppercase input field with instant validation and 'Connect Space' action button.
pairing_flow.paired_banner: Subtle top banner showing both partner avatars/initials linked with a heart / infinity icon.

calendar_tab.library: react-big-calendar month grid with custom CSS overrides for soft rounded days and terracotta event pills
calendar_tab.add_event_modal: Shadcn Dialog form containing Event Title, Start Date/Time, End Date/Time, Timezone display indicator, Category tag (Date Night, Anniversary, Trip, Reminder, Chore), and Note text area.
calendar_tab.delete_event: Confirmation dialog with smooth toast notification via sonner.
calendar_tab.timezone_note: Display explicit timezone notice so events align correctly between users in different zones.

chat_tab.thread_view: Vertical scroll message thread with smooth auto-scroll to latest message.

message_bubbles.user_sent: Terracotta pill (`bg-rose-600 text-white rounded-2xl rounded-tr-xs`) aligned right
message_bubbles.partner_received: Oat warm pill (`bg-stone-200 dark:bg-stone-800 text-stone-900 dark:text-stone-100 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-xs`) aligned left

chat_tab.chat_features: Timestamp display, simple heart reaction on double tap / long press, photo attachment quick preview.
chat_tab.input_bar: Sticky bottom input field with image pick icon, emoji picker button, and send button with keyboard send on Enter.

gallery_tab.upload_area: Drag-and-drop / click photo uploader supporting real image files (JPEG, PNG, WebP) with client-side preview, progress bar, and instant grid sync.
gallery_tab.photo_grid: Masonry or balanced Bento grid (3-4 columns desktop, 2 columns mobile) with hover zoom, upload date tag, caption overlay, and click-to-lightbox viewer.
gallery_tab.lightbox_modal: Full-screen photo viewer with download button, upload timestamp, photo caption, and delete photo button.

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components as per project convention.
Implement persistent or mock API layer for pairing code generation, event CRUD, chat messaging, and gallery image upload.
Use Sonner for toast feedback (e.g. 'Code copied to clipboard', 'Event added successfully', 'Image uploaded').
Ensure responsiveness on mobile viewports (< 640px) with bottom tab navigation bar.
Add empty, loading, and error states with heartwarming micro-copy and warm illustrations or icons.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT center align the entire app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Never use generic raw text inputs for dropdowns or dates where rich components exist.
Maintain generous padding inside cards and containers (p-4 to p-8).
Add transition effects for state changes (e.g., hover states, active tabs, modal openings).
Ensure code is clean, modular, and ready for production testing.
